metadata.environment: LLAM_* overrides removed; other host environment inherited
metadata.policy: one P; RELEASE_FAST; preemption OFF; same grain, yields, cancellations, input and exact uint32 outputs
metadata.training: All modes warm buffers with the same activation count. Auto-cold uses scalar during untimed warmup, leaving the family untrained; auto-warm uses real family observations. No synthetic timing or profile injection.
metadata.timing: elapsed excludes plan setup and training; setup and warmup/readiness wall times are retained separately; release/join are timed
metadata.baseline: ordinary C under identical compiler flags, without vectorization-disabling options
